reviewNotes: Twenty-five medical-condition, saloon, decoration, jewelry, dressmaking, and general item-request strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover placeholders, compatibility between request templates and location fragments, dynamic item grammar, medical terminology, leading and trailing spaces, signatures, punctuation, and character voice; both found no remaining objective issue.
